description: A script for detecting incorrect standard library uses in the Cobalt layer by analyzing unresolved symbols in binaries using 'nm'. It loads allowed symbols, ignores certain libraries, compares with a manifest, and reports leaks or updates the manifest.

methods.name: DiffWithManifest
methods.description: Compares leaked symbols with the manifest to find new leaks or removed leaks.

methods.name: FindLibraries
methods.description: Finds all static libraries in the build config directory, excluding ignored ones.

methods.name: FindLeakingSourceFiles
methods.description: Identifies source files that contain leaking symbols based on nm output.

methods.name: InversedKeys
methods.description: Swaps keys and inner keys in a nested dictionary.

methods.name: FindLeakLocations
methods.description: Locates static libraries and source files where leaked symbols are used.

methods.name: LoadAllowedC99Symbols
methods.description: Loads allowed C99 symbols from a markdown file.

methods.name: LoadManifest
methods.description: Loads the set of symbols from a manifest file.

methods.name: LoadLibrariesToIgnore
methods.description: Loads list of libraries to ignore during leak detection.

methods.name: ParseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for script operation modes and options.

methods.name: PrettyPrint
methods.description: Prints data structures in a readable format.

methods.name: ProcessNmOutput
methods.description: Parses 'nm' command output to extract unresolved symbols and file info.

methods.name: RunCommand
methods.description: Executes a system command and returns its output.
